title: Trendy-Tokens-AI
tagline: Never miss a profit just because you missed the trend! 🚀 Our AI agent scrapes platforms like Twitter & CoinGecko to find trending tokens in Meme, DeFi, ZK & AI—then invests for you! It also spots viral keywords, deploys memecoins, & lets you profit before the noobs. 💰🔥
description:
Recently, many of us missed out on the profits from Trump Coin simply because we were unaware of the trend. Our AI agents track internet trends for you and invest accordingly!

#1 Use Case:
It scans platforms like Twitter & CoinGecko to find trending tokens in Meme, DeFi, ZK & AI, investing in them for you—so you don’t have to wait to hear from friends. Get in early like a pro!

#2 Use Case:
Our agents monitor the web, identifying trending keywords that could become future meme coins. They even deploy a meme token for you—so others buy in, and you profit!
how_its_made:
Our agent is built using Coinbase AgentKit and is designed to enhance the DeFAI space. It is deployed on Autonome, leveraging its infrastructure for reliable and efficient execution.

To keep the agent up-to-date, we integrate CoinGecko and Twitter APIs, allowing it to scrape real-time market data, social sentiment, and trending discussions. This enables it to formulate an intelligent strategy for investing in trending tokens across Meme, DeFi, AI, and ZK categories.

Beyond investment, our agent actively monitors the web for emerging keywords that have the potential to become viral memecoins. When a promising trend is detected, it automatically deploys a meme token before the market catches on—positioning users ahead of the curve for maximum profit.

A particularly hacky aspect of our implementation is how we fine-tune the agent's decision-making by analyzing on-chain trends alongside social sentiment. This hybrid approach ensures smarter, data-driven investments and early memecoin deployments. 🚀
